newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS LOSE BOKSIC FOR TWO MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS LOSE BOKSIC FOR TWO MONTHS.

text.p: Italian league leaders Juventus will be without Croat international striker Alen Boksic for up to two months, far longer than expected, after x-rays revealed the extent of an ankle injury.
The Turin club said tests on Monday showed Boksic had also damaged ligaments around his left ankle.
"The limb will therefore need to be immobilised for 25-30 days after which the player will begin a programme of rehabilitative physiotherapy," the club said in a statement.
"The diagnosis for his return is around 60 days."
Juventus, the European Cup holders, play a European Supercup first leg against French side Paris St. Germain on Wednesday after a goalless draw at Atalanta on Sunday.
The Croat was injured in the 25th minute of the match, which left Juventus two points clear at the top of serie A, after a heavy clash with defender Fabio Rustico.
Juventus play Rosenborg of Norway in the first leg of a European Cup quarter-final on March 5 and the two-month hold means Boksic must also be doubtful for that match.
